svg.title: Finite sums of product Schwartz tests are dense in the joint Schwartz space. Here is the concrete approximation used. First take a compactly supported joint test φ, and choose a product cutoff χ(X) = Q i χi(Xi) equal to one on its support. Approximate its Fourier transform by compactly supported Fourier cutoffs. Inverting and multiplying by χ gives Schwartz convergence to φ. Each approximant is an integral over a compact frequency set of the tests
